content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-66. - Beautification.

faqs.a:
Median areas of all parkways and, where practical, all other open areas within the
               designated right-of-way, shall be beautified by appropriate landscaping. Detail plans
               for beautification shall be considered an integral part of the improvement plans for
               the construction of these streets so designated and shall be approved by the city
               engineer. In the case of staged construction, beautification plans shall be prepared
               and implemented as soon as possible after the completion and opening to vehicular
               traffic of the stage of construction undertaken. In the case of staged construction,
               beautification plans and construction shall be limited to that which can be permanently
               installed. The remainder of the rights-of-way shall be maintained in a manner comparable
               to other rights-of-way in the city.
(Code 1981, § 30-80; Ord. No. 1432, § 13, 3-6-1978)
